guizoom.button.tooltip: Zoom modes, mouse wheel behaviour and animation
guizoom.screen.title: GUI Zoom Settings
guizoom.screen.hint: Scroll the mouse wheel in any GUI to zoom.
guizoom.mode.vanilla.desc: Uses the real vanilla GUI scale option, exactly like the video settings slider. Integer steps, reflows every screen, maximum mod compatibility.
guizoom.mode.magnifier.desc: Magnifies the rendered GUI around the mouse cursor. The layout is untouched, so nothing is ever clipped or reflowed; move the mouse to pan the view.
guizoom.mode.fractional.desc: Continuous GUI scale like the vanilla one, but with decimal steps. The layout reflows, so everything stays on screen.
guizoom.mode.center.desc: Same render zoom as the magnifier, but anchored on the centre of the screen instead of the pointer.
